name: commandSearchAction
reason: Delegates to searchAll, which calls requireRole(OWNER, ADMIN, STAFF) and applies job-role permissions before any database access.

name: createTaskAction
reason: The domain task function calls requireRole for an authorized desk role before it reads or changes any task record.

name: updateTaskAction
reason: The domain task function calls requireRole for an authorized desk role before it reads or changes any task record.

name: completeTaskAction
reason: The domain task function calls requireRole for an authorized desk role before it reads or changes any task record.

name: reopenTaskAction
reason: The domain task function calls requireRole for an authorized desk role before it reads or changes any task record.

name: deleteTaskAction
reason: The domain task function calls requireRole for an authorized desk role before it reads or changes any task record.

name: linkMessageContextAction
reason: The domain function calls requireRole(OWNER, ADMIN) and assertActiveTeamActor inside its transaction before linking.

name: runPreviewStorageCheck
reason: The domain check calls getServerSession and refuses everyone except the OWNER before touching storage.

name: publicPrivacyRequestAction
reason: Public privacy-request form by design: rate limited by address, validates input, and creates only a privacy request record.

name: acceptInvitationAction
reason: The invitation code is the credential: the domain function validates the code, its state and expiry before creating the account.

name: submitTenantRepairAction
reason: The tenant repair link token is the credential: the domain function resolves the token to a single tenancy before accepting the report.

name: chooseQuoteLanguage
reason: The quote link id is the capability: the read validates the estimate is in an approvable state and the update touches only that quote's language.

name: checkServiceAddress
reason: Public service-area checker by design: rate limited by address and returns only whether an address can be served, never customer data.

name: submitLead
reason: Public contact form by design: rate limited by address with spam protection; creates only a lead enquiry.

name: submitLaunchSignup
reason: Public launch list signup by design: rate limited by address; joins only the launch mailing list.

name: confirmLaunchAction
reason: The emailed confirmation token is the credential: the domain function confirms only the subscription that token belongs to.

name: requestAccessAction
reason: The emergency link token is the credential: the domain vault function validates the token before notifying the owner or starting access.

name: sendCodeAction
reason: The emergency link token is the credential: the domain vault function validates the token and the pending request before sending a code.

name: confirmCodeAction
reason: The emergency link token plus the one-time code are the credentials: the domain vault function validates both before granting access.

name: pauseChargesAction
reason: The emergency link token is the credential: the domain vault function validates the token and the granted contact before pausing charges.

name: approveEstimateAction
reason: The quote link id is the capability: rate limited by address, and the domain function only approves an estimate in a sent, approvable state.

name: payEstimateDepositAction
reason: Rate limited by address; the domain function only starts a deposit checkout for an approved estimate that still owes a deposit.

name: requestEstimateChangesAction
reason: Rate limited by address; the domain function only records a change request on an estimate still open for responses.

name: declineEstimateAction
reason: Rate limited by address; the domain function refuses once the estimate is no longer offered (the replay refusal is proven in the cited test).

name: continueEstimateOrderAction
reason: Rate limited by address; the domain function only continues an approved order and returns a waiting/review state otherwise, never customer data.

name: sendFinishedOrderActivationAction
reason: Rate limited by address and estimate; the domain function sends nothing unless the order is READY_FOR_ACCOUNT for that estimate.

name: chooseDeliveryAction
reason: Rate limited by address; the domain function records the delivery choice only for the estimate and service address on the customer's own quote link.

name: signAgreementAction
reason: The signing link record id is the credential: rate limited, and the domain function signs only an agreement awaiting that signature.

name: submitTypedAction
reason: The W-9 link token is the credential: hashed-token and address rate limits, one-time link state checked in the domain before any submission is stored.

name: submitUploadAction
reason: The W-9 link token is the credential: hashed-token and address rate limits, one-time link state checked in the domain before any submission is stored.
